# Unix Creative Studio

> A small, friendly web, mobile and AI studio in Brussels, Belgium. We build websites and mobile apps, and help small businesses put AI to work (AI consulting) — with clear fixed prices, no tech talk and no stress. We work in English, French, Spanish and Dutch.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/web-design): a fast custom website that shows who you are, makes it easy to contact you and gets you found on Google and in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity). Timeline: 2-4 weeks. Includes structure, custom design, build for phone and computer, launch, Google and AI search setup (SEO/GEO), CMS and a short training.
- [AI consulting](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/ai-consulting): we find the task that slows a business down the most (answering clients, following up on quotes, sorting emails, booking appointments) and build an AI system that does it. First system live in 2-4 weeks. Method: free call to find the bottleneck, clear plan with hours saved and price, build with the tools the client already uses, launch and training, then weekly measurement and improvement.
- [Mobile app](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/mobile-app): an app for iPhone and Android so clients can book, buy and come back. First version in 8-10 weeks.

## How we work

1. Seed — you fill in a short form or take a 30 min call.
2. Plant — within 48 hours you get a clear plan, a fixed price and a fixed date, in writing.
3. Grow — we build; you see the progress and approve every step.
4. Bloom — launch day: the website, app or AI system is live and working.

## Good to know

- Clients can hire a single service (only a website, only an AI system…).
- The client owns the website, the domain and all accounts.
- One year of free technical bug fixes after launch.
- No call needed: the form, email or WhatsApp work fine.
